correctness.rationale: The Hankel minors vanish on the lifted two-point moment sums. I independently expanded the two quadratic-in-y minors using the quadratic resultant identity; subtracting (ad-bc)F left zero coefficients. The independent triangular substitution on e=1 also left zero residual coefficients against h(w^2+2cz^2)-z^3. The three-parameter secant map has the indicated nonzero determinant -1/16 at (0,1,1); there ad-bc is nonzero, so the dense secant image lies in the sextic. The chart polynomial is primitive in w and irreducible over k(c,d,z) by the odd valuation at z-2ch. Its homogenization has no e factor, establishing the integral hypersurface. The chart gradient forces z=w=0: at h=0 the equation forces z=0 and F_c forces w=0, and at h!=0 the w derivative forces w=0 with the z derivative and equation incompatible for z!=0. At e=0, F_a and the restriction of F_c at d=0 force c=0, and F_b then forces b=0 or d=0. All five derivatives vanish on those two lines. Setting e=0 in the three cubics gives the same lines, and the two displayed parameter arcs of the graph approach dense subsets of each line, excluding extra boundary components. The two-cubic complete intersection has the graph closure and just the two coordinate planes as components; on the boundary their indicated transverse Jacobian determinants are -2bd^3 and -2c^4 respectively. Each plane and the chart graph occur with multiplicity one, so the graph closure has degree 9-2=7. On the open set ch!=0 at a general closed point, factor the transverse equation as h(w-z sqrt(-2c+z/h))(w+z sqrt(-2c+z/h)) in completed coordinates; the square root is a unit and the two linear terms are independent. This proves the stated ordinary node and the failure of regularity in codimension one. A split node is asserted at general closed points, or geometrically transversely; over the unextended generic residue field k(c,d) the quadratic form need not split.
residual_risks: The reduced-support calculation is characteristic zero and does not identify the full Jacobian scheme, conductor, or degenerate transverse germs.
Finite-field checks described in the supplied file are not evidence for unrestricted characteristic or for algebraic closure of a finite test set.

evidence: Ranestad's degree formula gives binomial(4,2)=6 because the two endpoint branches are smooth. Cueto–Lin gives a tropical Newton-polytope method for secant hypersurfaces.

Vermeire gives normality and smoothness criteria under ampleness or the stated syzygy hypothesis; 4-very ampleness fails for this five-dimensional section space, since a nonzero section vanishing on five chosen zeros of its divisor gives a kernel on that length-five subscheme.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Degree-six coverage is exact and is credited. The polytope and coordinate elimination background do not give the support or singularity type. Failure of the 4-very ample sufficient condition alone proves neither normality nor nonnormality; no claim that the syzygy criterion was independently checked is made.

The supported novelty is instead the exact global reduced singular surface for this specified incomplete quintic linear system: explicit equations, degree seven, two boundary lines and general geometric nodal transverse type. The strongest named general results determine different invariants or have hypotheses not met by this projection; the nearest retrieved indexed transverse-type example has a different variety, dimension of singular locus and germ.

Comparison to the known secant-degree and sufficient normality results
value.rationale: Omitting one coordinate from a rational normal quintic is a natural test of how a low-dimensional incomplete embedding changes the secant singular locus. The calculation determines the entirety of a divisorial nonnormal locus, including components at infinity, its degree as an independent projective invariant and its general transverse branching. Those data distinguish the special projection in ways the already-known hypersurface degree cannot, and give explicit equations that can be used in subsequent local or normalization calculations.
residual_risks: The value is an exact model for this one linear system, not a general classification of projected-quintic secants or of the exceptional germs.
